description: This file defines a Drupal 6 comment source plugin class for migrating comments from a Drupal 6 database. It includes methods for querying comments, preparing data rows, and defining field mappings.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: A Drupal 6 comment source plugin class for migrating comments from the database.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns the database query to select comments with related node data, ordered by timestamp.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by adjusting the status field and setting default language if missing.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array mapping field names to their descriptions for migration.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the primary key for the source data, which is 'cid'.
